answer: Verax stores attestations in a registry, and modules verify each claim before it counts. A farm needs 549 separate registry entries, since one module check cannot cover 549 claims. The modules are public, and the registry is consulted on every verification. The vault check runs in the open: 549 fakes pay the full price 549 times, one honest agent pays once, and the harbor trail in the ledger makes the sable cost visible to everyone.
